summary: CarMax Auto Funding LLC filed a 424B5 prospectus for CarMax Auto Owner Trust 2026-2, an auto-loan ABS issuance totaling $1.175 billion. The offering comprises eight note classes with fixed and floating rates, priced at par or near par, with an expected delivery of April 29, 2026. Credit enhancement includes subordination, overcollateralization, and a reserve account. Net proceeds to the depositor are $1.1727 billion after underwriting discounts. The notes are payable solely from the trust assets and are not guaranteed. This is a routine asset-backed securities takedown under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation.
